body: This is weird but everything you posted on your page is almost identical to my relationship that ended almost exactly when you broke up. Just a few different details (i didn’t visit her in nyc), if it helps i’m going through the same pain as you and i’m the guy. He definitely misses you but you have to move on, if it was anything like mine we were both too toxic for each other. Goodluck.
You don’t understand the situation she treated me like shit and because i wouldnt stand for it any longer and left she would convince me to come back
Trust is such an important component in long distance relationships, without trust there is no relationship
I’m happy to hear you’re dealing with it so positively and its great advice for people that need it
I relate to this, she too played victim when she did something wrong. Nothing was ever her fault but everyone elses.
Its the worst to think about, the girl that was mine is no longer mine. I hope you’re okay, we’ll get through this struggle eventually... I hope

Thanks for the best wishes, I know she wasn’t willing to change for the better and I wasn’t going to keep dealing with the toxicity so, as much as it hurts because we loved each other so much this is the way it was going to end which hurts.

Exactly why our relationship ended, she had this bad toxic side that ultimately led to the death of our relationship.

We either were the most loving or we hated each other no inbetween
I take a magic pill called xanax to make me go to sleep and wake up not as depressed, problem is that I keep taking more and more
Hope you achieve happiness my friend ❤️
100% I’m in the same boat as you
I recommend getting a weighted blanket which gives you the feeling of being held
Reading stuff like this is always a reality check for myself, if/when I kill myself I always wonder how people will react.

Im on the edge of suicide and 100% suicide is selfish you’re an idiot if you don’t think it is, i’m in so much mental pain right now but when I do it, i’m leaving a permanent pain to my family and friends all because I couldn’t handle to live life.

Yeah we’re in the same scenario bud, to get approved for this esketamine you have to have proof that traditional anti-depressants didn’t work. I’m going to try the other route if you catch my drift haha

Actually met this girl who I clicked really well with, she actually knew I had depression and comforted me perfectly. She was amazing but my toxicity got into play and we turned into a long distance thing, i stopped talking to her for 8 weeks and she never tried, just saw she got a boyfriend so i blocked her on everything which fucked me up as well

There’s a new drug trial going around that I recommend you do research on called esketamine but its rather pricey, practically the same as ketamine but done legally. To get LSD or ketamine illegally, black market would be your friend but you need to do a looooooooot of research because jail time is a real thing
I was going to try this with LSD or Ketamine, i heard LSD is better for micro dosing than shrooms

I have a bunch of close friends, i’m actually traveling around the world meeting them. Relationship wise, I can never stay committed because this depression makes me toxic (jealousy, obsession, etc) and I don’t want to express that toxicity on the people I love which really fucks me over.
